list_characters.description: List Demon Slayer characters one page at a time, in id order, with each one's age, gender, race, description, picture and quote. Set Limit for the page size and Page to walk the roster; the result says how many there are in all and has_more says whether another page follows.

description: Look up Demon Slayer data using the free, keyless Demon Slayer API: page through the characters and the breathing and combat styles, search either collection by name, and fetch any single record by id, with a character's affiliation, first story arc and combat styles. No account or API key required. Disclaimer: this is an independent integration with the community-run Demon Slayer API (demonslayer-api.com).
